usage: Declarative steady contract. Convert a genuine verified legacy model spec using runtime/prepare_steady_spec.py; not a simulator launcher.

observations.instruction: Sort the objects by category into the three baskets.
observations.history_source_frame_rule: floor(2.5*k), k=0,1,... on the25Hz action clock
observations.past_frames: Strictly before the current frame, same episode, uniformly selected from every captured source point over the complete prefix; preserve first/last when subsampling.
observations.image_order: Selected past MAIN images in time order, then current MAIN/left-wrist/right-wrist.

executed_history.commit: Only after validated actual-execution ACK, including episode, exact ID/text/prompt/commands, action range and physics clock.
executed_history.contradiction_handling: Stop and preserve evidence; no automatic in-goal ID correction

timeouts.timed_out_HTTP_child: Kill and reap the exact request child before returning or retrying; key enters only private stdin.
timeouts.retry_scope: Only preserved transport/transient429/5xx and empty public-content length errors; body remains identical.
timeouts.budget_scope: ONE shared observer plus selector admission budget; not1850 for each call

policy.inputs: Current3RGB, State14 and composed prompt only; selector history is not sent to pi0.5.
policy.success_and_termination: Original SDK rules, including partial final execution ACK when native termination occurs.

evaluation_scope_for_provenance_only: New code; no actual API/GPU/native evaluation launched or measured by these changes.
deployment_limits: Preserved runtime retains original namespace, layout/SDK, checkpoint identity and file-stat guards.
No checkpoint, normalizer, tokenizer, OpenPI, SDK, simulator, GPU environment or original layout assets are bundled.
CPU mocked behavior tests do not establish real API/GPU/native acceptance or scientific/semantic success.
Original prepare_native_sim.py is historical pilot material and is not a current quickstart.

steady_constraints.goal_lock: Until two distinct released in-destination observations of the same physical instance AFTER selection and the most recent unplaced witness, including current frame
steady_constraints.category_to_basket: Observed released placements only; not selected/executed textual plans
steady_constraints.ambiguous_or_conflicting_evidence: Decision stop before policy; SDK_outcome remains null
steady_constraints.final_goal_no_next_target: Retain supported goal completion; record a decision stop with SDK_outcome null
steady_constraints.new_destination_visibility: Current inspected basket contents required for every new goal, including assigned baskets; active goal stays locked through occlusion
steady_constraints.lifecycle_rpc_overlap: Nonblocking per-model and per-provider gates reject overlapping calls before mutation; model gate spans API and policy inference
steady_constraints.delayed_old_episode_request: Reject before decision-stop handler; no new API call or new-episode stop latch
